part: I. Information and logic: computation without time
question: What can be computed from two bits, and from which pieces?
statement: L01 Every function of at most two bits: What can be computed from two bits, and from which pieces?
title: Every function of at most two bits
why_here: The smallest level with a computation in it, and the only one small enough to finish: 16 objects, 4 rows, every search runs to the end. Functions of one bit cannot be combined into anything new (the model checks that no set of them is complete), so two bits is the smallest complete piece.
